title: GM Targets 2 Year Vehicle Cycle to Match Chinese Rivals
summary:
General Motors is restructuring its software and autonomous driving capabilities to accelerate the production of new models. The automaker intends to use artificial intelligence to shorten vehicle development cycles to as little as 2 years to keep pace with the speed of rivals in China. This shift is part of a broader strategy to deploy a new generation of autonomous cars and leapfrog other industry competitors.

The tech overhaul includes the rollout of a native OnStar AI assistant, which debuts in the 2027 Cadillac Lyrio via an over-the-air update in the coming months. Following the initial launch for the Lyrio, GM will integrate the AI interface into additional vehicle models across its fleet.
